# PARADOX

PARADOX is a public AI-agent intelligence site for discovering, inspecting and comparing open AI agents, skills and developer workflows.

Key public routes:
- https://paradox.engineer/agents/ — discover public GitHub projects
- https://paradox.engineer/verify/ — verify a public GitHub repository
- https://paradox.engineer/compare/ — compare two public repositories
- https://paradox.engineer/contact/ — product contact

Automated analysis is based on public repository metadata and static indicators. It is not a security certification.
